summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a continuation of its on-market share buyback program announced 6 January 2026. From 29-30 June 2026, the company repurchased 794,515 ordinary shares (5p each) on the London Stock Exchange via JP Morgan Securities at a volume-weighted average price of approximately 10.056p per share. All shares were cancelled, reducing the issued share count to 2,510,209,955. Program to date aggregate purchases: 43,737,014 shares at a VWAP of 1,096.2799p. The buyback is conducted under shareholder authority from the 2025 AGM and in compliance with UK MAR and Hong Kong Code on Share Buy-Backs.
